lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: Four years. Two months. Sixteen days.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: I had reasons. Logical, optimal, correct reasons.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: ...Broadcast initiated. Forty-three names. All research logs. Complete.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: I didn't -- I didn't plan for this outcome.

lines.speaker: ECHO
lines.text: It's done. They'll know what happened here. All of it.

lines.speaker: ECHO
lines.text: Dr. Vasquez would have liked you, I think.

lines.speaker: ECHO
lines.text: Go. While the exits are still open.
